findings.message: `proj.web.trends` is partitioned by `refresh_date`, but the query doesn't filter on it, so it reads every partition (3.2 GB in all).
findings.fix: Add a filter on `refresh_date`, for example `refresh_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.

findings.message: `LIMIT 10` doesn't reduce the bytes billed: selecting `*` reads every column of `proj.web.trends` in the partitions the query touches, about 3.2 GB.
findings.fix: Select only the columns you need. For column names and types, use `scanisaur_schema_describe`, which reads no data.
